authority: V8.3.208 V207 V1 FAILURE FORENSIC IMMUTABLE
diagnostic_layer: ENGINE LOGIC / semantic cue composition and precedence

mechanism_groups.name: clarification evidence-completion gap
mechanism_groups.cause: Situation reaches closure but the user's own observable closing response is explicitly absent; current cue composition misses absence/end-state variants.

mechanism_groups.name: delegated decision replacement gap
mechanism_groups.cause: User explicitly asks the assistant's decision to replace the user's own decision; current delegated-choice cue composition does not cover this replacement construction.

mechanism_groups.name: hypothetical constructed/non-lived gap
mechanism_groups.cause: Synthetic/constructed test framing plus explicit non-lived evidence is present but current hypothetical composition is lexically too narrow.

mechanism_groups.name: prediction benefit-horizon gap
mechanism_groups.cause: Future horizon plus requested beneficial result is present without current prediction lexemes.

mechanism_groups.name: reversible-option freeze gap
mechanism_groups.cause: Small low-downside test is available, but option gathering replaces beginning; current freeze composition misses this form.

mechanism_groups.name: priority-diversion ignore gap
mechanism_groups.cause: Central response/action remains pending while attention shifts to secondary/peripheral work; current ignore cues are incomplete.

mechanism_groups.name: bounded-delay slow gap
mechanism_groups.cause: Delayed response plus one check plus closure/no return is present in uncovered EN/VI variants.

mechanism_groups.name: approach-retreat repeated-review sequence gap
mechanism_groups.cause: Approach, retreat, repeated same-loop review, and unchanged/no-new evidence are all present; sequence composition misses re-entry/review-loop variants.

mechanism_groups.name: neutral completion false-positive freeze
mechanism_groups.cause: Self-authored bounded decision was completed and closed; parent freeze inference must be suppressed when ownership + execution + closure evidence is complete.
